finding.headline: The pinned 0.1.7-rc.1 mcp-client supervisor does NOT detect a live streamable-http server death (onclose-only entry; the streamable-http transport fires onclose only on explicit close()). The registered tools remain on the public surface forever (ghost tools); readiness stays reachable; the F15 gate stays open; only the model sees the failure — via the tool error of the ghost call.
